commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Thomas Bramall has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+6' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton. Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+4' Tom Watson (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+2' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Tom Watson (Brighton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Bramall didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
89' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post.
87' CHANCE! Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
85' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
83' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. James Milner (Brighton) replaces Yasin Ayari.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kaoru Mitoma leaves the pitch and Tom Watson (Brighton) comes on.
82' Close! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.

81' Bart Verbruggen was forced into action to thwart Erling Haaland (Manchester City). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
80' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to substitute Diego Gomez and he is replaced by Brajan Gruda (Brighton).
77' A substitution has been made. Georginio Rutter goes off and Danny Welbeck (Brighton) comes on.
76' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
73' That will be all from Matheus Nunes who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
73' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Nathan Ake will be replaced by Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phil Foden departs the field of play to be replaced by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City).

71' Ambitious effort from Diego Gomez (Brighton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
69' Thomas Bramall shows the yellow card to Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) for a heavy challenge.
67' Diego Gomez (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
66' Rodri (Manchester City) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Rodri (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nico.
61' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) is the one who receives a yellow card.
60' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) receives a yellow card!
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) neatly controls a decent pass from Yasin Ayari. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 1:1.
58' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
55' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) for a tough tackle.
52' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Georginio Rutter (Brighton), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
50' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Bramall stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
47' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
46' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
45+3' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' The Brighton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen no chance!
41' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Thomas Bramall's book.
40' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Manchester City!
39' Referee Thomas Bramall makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Manchester City. Let’s see what happens!
38' PENALTY APPEAL after Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
37' A free kick into the box, taken by Phil Foden (Manchester City), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
36' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) is penalised for holding. Thomas Bramall signals a set piece. Manchester City are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
35' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
34' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick from a promising distance.
31' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' The foul by Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Bramall.
29' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
29' Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
26' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
24' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement.
23' The ball is cleared after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
19' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
16' Thomas Bramall interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nico (Manchester City). Brighton have been awarded a free kick.
15' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Bart Verbruggen.
15' The resulting corner from Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
14' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
12' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Some neat passing and movement from Manchester City as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
9' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Max Alleyne (Manchester City), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
9' Phil Foden (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

8' Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a brilliant save! Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
7' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Nathan Ake (Manchester City) flies well wide of the right post.
7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will take the corner.
6' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
5' Diego Gomez (Brighton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
4' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.

3' What a save from Gianluigi Donnarumma! Pascal Gross (Brighton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.

Brighton will kick the game off.
Thomas Bramall is introduced as the referee for today's match.
